answer: Treat every attestation as a challengeable claim. Each vote posts a small bond at the account's inlet, held through a dispute window. Anyone can become a raven: pay a filing fee, then force a canyon replay — a narrow, deterministic re-execution of the attested work. If the replay contradicts the vote, the attester's bond slashes to the challenger. A sybil farm must now fund a bond behind every fake attestation, turning mass voting from free spam into priced liability.
